narrative.overview: Borno Higher Study is designed as an authoritative, high-trust institution directory and admissions governance portal. Its visual tone is editorial, disciplined, and scholarly—resembling the precision of a national academic gazette combined with modern digital utility.
keyCharacteristics: Scholarly Authority: Deep navy foundations paired with clean white surfaces.
Data Clarity Over Decoration: Tabular numerals for living costs and deadlines.

rules.name: The Verification Contrast Rule
rules.body: Every verified checkmark, deadline countdown, and fee figure must render with minimum 4.5:1 contrast against its immediate container.

rules.name: The Tabular Currency Rule
rules.body: All fees in BDT, USD, EUR, and GBP, intake countdown counters, and university statistics must utilize tabular numerals.

rules.name: The No-Frivolous-Glow Rule
rules.body: No neon box-shadows, blurred backdrop glows, or colored drop shadows.

dos: Format all financial figures with their respective currency symbol and clear BDT conversion rates.
State verified timestamps and official primary documentation links on admission requirements.
Provide clear focus outlines for keyboard navigation across all interactive elements.
donts: Don't use decorative purple-to-blue gradients or glossy glassmorphism.
Don't nest cards inside cards more than 1 level deep.
Don't use low-contrast gray text on white or colored backgrounds.
